items.source: Once in effect, the auto-configuration allows to configure any property of RepositoryRestConfiguration using the spring.data.rest prefix.
items.translation: 一旦生效，自动配置允许使用 `spring.data.rest` 前缀来配置 RepositoryRestConfiguration 的任何属性。

items.source: Activates when the application is a web application and no RepositoryRestMvcConfiguration is found.
items.translation: 当应用程序为 Web 应用程序且未找到 RepositoryRestMvcConfiguration 时激活。

items.source: Rob Winch, Stephane Nicoll, Andy Wilkinson
items.translation: Rob Winch, Stephane Nicoll, Andy Wilkinson
